sources.snippet: OpenThinker-7B This model is a fine-tuned version of Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on the OpenThoughts-114k dataset dataset. The dataset is derived by distilling DeepSeek-R1 using the data pipeline available on github. More info about the dataset can be found on the dataset card at OpenThoughts-114k dataset.
